LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANT DEIDRE ROTHSCHILD'S MOTION TO SET ASIDE DEFAULT/DEFAULT JUDGMENT/LEAVE TO DEFEND. MOVING AND OPPOSING PARTIES APPEARED. ARGUED AND THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING. MOTION TO SET ASIDE DEFAULT/DEFAULT JUDGMENT/LEAVE TO DEFEND -- DENIED. PREVAILING PARTY IS TO PREPARE AN ORDER. DEFENDANT'S ORAL REQUEST FOR A STAY UNDER CCP1176(A) WAS HEARD. PURSUANT TO STIPULATION, THE COURT GRANTED A STAY ON THE CONDITION THAT DEFENDANT IS TO PAY PLAINTIFF $4,208 (4 MONTHS RENT INLCUDING THIS MONTH) ON 10/28/02. AND AFTERWARDS DEFENDANT IS TO PAY $1,052 TO PLAINTIFF ON THE 1ST DAY EVERY MONTH UNTIL THE STAY IS LIFTED. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. HON. JAMES J. MCBRIDE, REPORTER: LORETTA NAJERA, CSR# 5153
